control_failures.control_label: positive communication before approaching mobile equipment
segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: corrective action following learning team review at HT-9005

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control POSITIVE_COMMUNICATION_BEFORE_APPROACH: the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

Control PROXIMITY_DETECTION_AND_SEGREGATION: the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment on HT-9005 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling traffic on operating areas, specifically parking, chocking and restraining equipment. HT-9005 (haul trucks) is in service for waste and ore haulage. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment was in place but did not perform. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 26 July 2022 a corrective action on HT-9005 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop was reviewed against the material unwanted event control it was raised to restore.
